versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Initial release of hotel-amenity-clip.
- Turns each existing hotel amenity still into a dedicated short amenity video.
- Supports pool, gym, lobby, and custom-named amenities; one video per labeled photo.
- Enforces strict use of supplied photos and amenity names only.
- Detailed planning, inspection, and confirmation steps before any paid video generation.
- All processing routed exclusively through the bundled client for upload, video creation, and task monitoring.
